quote.text:
Opus 5.5 just crushed GPT-6 Sol in my latest game-dev test — and it wasn’t close.

Both got the same challenge:
One prompt. One HTML file. Full autopilot.
GPT-6 Sol was faster and produced a smaller, cleaner build.

But Opus built the better game.

🐟 Sol
• 1 generic fish
• 2 basic upgrades
• Simple gameplay loop
• Polished tech-demo feel

🎣 Opus
• 5 distinct fish species
• Rarity tiers
• Perfect-catch mechanics
• 3 progression trees
• Dynamic fish schools
• Minimap
• Persistent save system
That’s the difference that stood out to me:
Sol optimized the benchmark.
Opus understood the product.
FPS and file size look great on a chart.
But when the goal is to actually build a game people want to play, feature depth and systems matter a lot more.

Full side-by-side below 👇
